purpose: Runs Squire's one-off set-up and its deploy against a loopback stand-in of Cloudflare's API, and the safety floor as the session runs it, to check that the token Squire keeps can deploy and nothing else and that a site is previewed on this Mac before its deploy is asked.
title: Websites: the deploy-only token and the preview first

testCases.description: the kept token deploys the site and nothing else, read back as deploy-only
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/website-token-and-preview.test.js::the token the set-up keeps deploys the site and nothing else: a call it makes to read or change billing, tokens, account settings, DNS or another product is refused, the set-up reports done only after reading its rights back as deploy-only, and the deploy waits out a new address's certificate before it reports the site live

testCases.description: a set-up that would keep a token wider than deploy-only does not finish and keeps none
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/website-token-and-preview.test.js::a set-up that would keep a token wider than deploy-only does not finish and keeps no token: one carrying another right, one on every account, one on every zone as well

testCases.description: the deploy uses only the kept token, never a sign-in or a token already on the Mac
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/website-token-and-preview.test.js::Squire's deploy uses only the token the set-up kept, on the set-up's account: a wrangler sign-in already on the Mac and a Cloudflare token or account in the environment are never used, though either would work

testCases.description: a site is previewed on the loopback from its folder before its deploy is asked
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/website-token-and-preview.test.js::a site is previewed on this Mac, on the loopback from its own folder, before its deploy is asked: what the session loads says so, the floor does not ask for the deploy until the owner has previewed the site, and a site changed since its last preview waits for a new one, in the default mode and in auto mode

testCases.description: a site preview not bound to the loopback is refused, not asked, even after a yes
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/website-token-and-preview.test.js::in a site job the owner said yes to, a site preview by Python's http.server with no loopback bind or bound beyond the loopback is refused, not asked, even after a yes, in the default mode and in auto mode
